query: Draw the architecture of this codebase.
setup: React app under src/ with Feature-Sliced Design folders app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared; about 30 slices
dependency-cruiser is installed as a devDependency
entities/cart imports from features/add-to-cart (an upward import), and two features import each other
expected_behavior: Detects FSD and uses its seven-layer vocabulary and downward import rule without asking
Runs dependency-cruiser in JSON mode since it is installed, and builds the slice graph from it instead of grepping imports

Writes docs/codebase-map.md with a layers x slices flowchart (one subgraph per layer, one node per slice), marking the upward import and the cross-import in red via classDef without prose recommendations
Includes a health table per slice with file count, fan-in, fan-out, cycles, and a violations column with raw counts
Keeps every diagram under 40 nodes, splitting by layer or capability when needed
Reads docs/feature-map.md if present to label slices with their capability; absent, does not fail
